frequency_question: How often do threatened indefinite strikes by major bank union coalitions actually result in the commencement of the strike within the final 5-day window versus being called off or deferred due to settlements?
membership_rule: Includes any formally announced nationwide banking sector strike threat by recognized union coalitions; excludes local single-bank disputes or non-financial sectors.
window: 5-day observation window prior to strike date
coverage_note: 7 major documented threat cycles in the past 4 years; captures most recent comparable actions.
known_gaps: Minor regional warning calls below national federation level might be omitted.
validity_reason: Labor negotiation patterns and conciliation frameworks remain stable over a 1-to-2-year horizon.
